title: Immunocytochemistry Protocol
author: Yasmin Bar El
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tqdems6
materials: Permeabilize with 0.5% triton X-100 (Sigma-Aldrich) in PBS for 10 min 00:10:00 .

steps.title: Wash culture twice with PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the cell culture two times with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Fix cells with 4% PFA
steps.instruction: Fix the cells with 4 % paraformaldehyde (Merck) for 10 min, then keep the cultures in PBS until the staining steps.

steps.title: Wash fixed cells three times
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cultures three times with PBS, each wash lasting 10 min.

steps.title: Block with BSA/serum/Triton solution
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells in a blocking solution containing 2 % BSA, 10 % normal donkey serum, and 0.25 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate overnight with primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Add rabbit anti‑GFAP (1:400, Sigma‑Aldrich, cat# G9269, RRID: AB_477035) and mouse anti‑NeuN (1:200, Millipore, cat# MAB377, RRID: AB_2298772) to the blocked cells and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash three times with PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the cultures three times with PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells for 1 h at room temperature with the appropriate secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti‑rabbit IgG (1:400, Jackson Laboratories) for GFAP detection and Cy‑3 donkey anti‑mouse IgG (1:700, Jackson Laboratories) for NeuN.

steps.title: Mount with DAPI‑containing medium
steps.instruction: Mount the stained cells using VECTASHIELD Mounting Medium with DAPI (Vector Laboratories, H‑1200).
